widget.prompt: How is the decimal 0.07 read as a number name?

options.label: 7 ones
options.feedback: 7 ones would be the whole number 7, with no decimal point needed. The digits after the point name parts of one whole, not whole units.

options.label: 70 hundredths
options.feedback: 70 hundredths is 0.70 — a full 7-column amount. The zero in the tenths place of 0.07 means there are no full columns, only 7 single hundredths.

options.label: 7 hundredths
options.feedback: Correct — the 7 sits two places after the point, in the hundredths place, so 0.07 names 7 hundredths.

options.label: 7 tenths
options.feedback: 7 tenths would be written 0.7, with the 7 directly after the point. In 0.07 a zero holds the tenths place, pushing the 7 into the hundredths place.
